data.one_liner: Pure Dart library to create and read Apple PkPass and order files for Apple Wallet.
data.what_it_does: Allows reading, writing, signing, and managing Apple Wallet PkPass and order tracking files. It works on servers, web, and mobile apps in pure Dart.
use_when: You need to generate Apple Wallet passes or order tracking files on a server or within an app.
You need to parse or update existing PkPass binary files.
avoid_when: You need a complete mobile UI widget set out-of-the-box (requires passkit_ui for widgets).
You need to interact directly with Apple's native PassKit framework APIs (use apple_passkit instead).
strengths: Pure Dart implementation working across servers and Flutter clients.
Supports both reading and properly signing PkPass files for Apple Wallet.
weaknesses: Push notification updates are only supported on iOS.
Localization currently uses UTF-8 instead of UTF-16 which may cause edge-case issues.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up Apple certificates and private keys for proper pass signing.

alternatives.name: apple_passkit
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this if you want to work with Apple's native PassKit APIs instead of a pure Dart parsing/generation library.
